title: Lesson 24: Conditional Logic, Loops & Branching in IPs
description: Apply conditional logic, loops, and branching within IPs to control the execution path.

questions.question: An IP should call a credit-check API only for amounts over a threshold. What controls this?
options: Conditional logic on the amount JSON path
questions.explanation: Conditionals gate actions based on data values.

questions.question: How does an IP process a list of line items one at a time?
options: A loop over the line items array
questions.explanation: Loops iterate arrays so per-item actions can run.

questions.question: Which IP capability chooses between different action paths for different inputs?
questions.explanation: Branching routes execution based on input state.
